standard-dialogue.npc: You're not aristocracy but I suppose you'd do. Do you want a good cook for 3000 coins?

steps.npc: I am the finest cook in all Gielinor! I can also make good time going to the bank or the sawmill.

options.text: Tell me about your previous jobs

steps.player: Tell me about your previous jobs.

steps.npc: I used to be the cook for the old Duke of Lumbridge. Visiting dignitaries praised me for my fine banquets!
But then someone found a rule that said that only one family could hold that post.
Overnight I was fired and replaced by some fool who can't even bake a cake without help!

steps.text: If the player does not have at least 30 Construction:

steps.npc: Hmph! I don't work for just anyone, you know! I refuse to work for someone who's below level 30 Construction!

steps.text: If the player has a servant already:
If the player does not have a second bedroom with a bed:
You need a second bedroom with a bed for your servant to sleep in.
If the player does not have enough money in their inventory:

steps.player: You're hired... well, I don't have the money on me, but can I owe you? I'm good for it, honest.

steps.npc: Are you having a laugh? No cash up front, no cook.

steps.text: If the player has the above conditions met and the player doesn't have a servant:

steps.npc: [Alright, sir./Alright, madam./Alright.] I can start work immediately.
